name: print-social-black-friday-phone-shop-window-awning-illustration
title: Black Friday sale illustration: a giant tilted phone rendered as a pink-and-black shop window with an awning
whatItIs: A tilted 3D phone whose screen is illustrated as a boutique shop window with a striped pink awning, a display of a shoe, lipstick and gift box, a 'Black Friday Sale' circle badge, and a pink 'Discount up to 85%' rounded banner across the base.
whatItMeans: Charming and clear; turning a phone into a literal shop window makes 'shopping from your phone' visually explicit.
techniques: Turn a device screen into a literal illustrated scene.
Use a shop awning to signal retail instantly.
Angle the whole object for a dynamic hero composition.

vocabulary.definition: Treating a device screen as an illustrated environment rather than a UI.
A striped fabric canopy, a classic retail storefront cue.
